name: dedicated_server
_thresholds: B123: three clients + bots start crowded; a teammate brushing a predicting client (it collides with where it sees the teammate, a few ticks in the past) spikes the error to ~0.5 m for a second -- 7 such samples decided p95 (0.18 in 3 of ~12 runs, 0.02-0.13 otherwise). Contact with remote mechs is a known prediction limit; 0.25 still catches movement code that diverges.
_comment: T204: the server runs the real --server mode (Game.start_dedicated: Lobby scene, no own entry, team size 2, waits for 2 players). Both clients reach it through the real menus (Title -> Hangar -> FIND MATCH -> JOIN -> Lobby -> READY); the server's lobby countdown starts match 1 (no host click), the server ends it at tick 240 (Match.force_end), both clients click BACK TO LOBBY + READY, and the countdown starts match 2. dedicated: dedicated start line, one countdown start per match, no peer-1 mech anywhere, both clients reach both matches.
